summary: Donnelley Financial Solutions, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing that Executive Vice President Craig Clay will transition out of his role as President of Global Capital Markets, becoming an advisor through December 31, 2026, with termination and severance per the company's Executive Severance Plan. Separately, Ken Napolitano will join as Chief Revenue Officer on June 1, 2026. No financial terms, shareholder vote impact, or board recommendation were provided. The filings also report routine Annual Meeting results including director elections and ratification of auditors. What to watch: orderly succession ensures continuity; no apparent activist or strategic catalyst driving changes.
